mapper.select: SELECT a.ANSWER_ID as answerId, a.QUESTION_ID as questionId, a.IS_ADOPTED as isAdopted, l.MEMBER_ID as memberId /* 💡 삭제 권한 체크를 위해 memberId 추가 */ FROM TB_ANSWER a JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON a.LAWYER_ID = l.LAWYER_ID WHERE a.ANSWER_ID = #{answerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ANSWER ( ANSWER_ID, QUESTION_ID, LAWYER_ID, CONTENT, IS_ADOPTED, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_ANSWER.NEXTVAL, #{questionId}, #{lawyerId}, #{content}, 'N', SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ANSWER SET CONTENT = #{content}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE ANSWER_ID = #{answerId}
UPDATE TB_ANSWER SET IS_ADOPTED = 'Y', ADOPTED_AT = SYSDATE, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE ANSWER_ID = #{answerId}
